claim.statement: Google's dated 2 February 2026 Jules changelog says selected MCP service connections can be configured with API-key authentication and Jules can trigger their tools when it detects a need during a session.

source.title: MCP support comes to Jules
source.locator: Overview; Getting started; Focus on Security

values: selected supported MCP service connected with API key
Jules session with configured MCP connection

limitations: The dated launch entry names an initial server set but is not treated as a current exhaustive compatibility list.
The publisher's statements about data flow and permission review are not an independent security evaluation.
unknowns: The currently supported MCP servers, enabled tools, permissions, data destinations and credential handling for a real account are unknown.
Which tool calls Jules would autonomously select, and with what side effects, was not tested.
